input-field.name: enabled
input-field.label: Let customers ship to several addresses
Lieferung an mehrere Adressen erlauben

input-field.name: shippingCostMode
input-field.label: Shipping charge
Versandkosten
input-field.helpText: Once per order: the shipping method is priced on the whole cart and charged once. Per destination: each address is priced as its own shipment with the shipping method's price matrix.
Einmal pro Bestellung oder je Lieferadresse als eigene Sendung.

input-field.name: additionalDestinationFee
input-field.label: Fee per additional destination
Gebühr je weiterer Lieferadresse
input-field.helpText: Optional handling fee added to each destination beyond the first, in the default currency. Taxed like that destination's shipping.
